title: Mean Distance
description: Essential Criteria - The mean distance traveled by the J/psi before decaying must be correctly calculated.

title: Decay Electron Energy
description: Essential Criteria - The energy of the decay electron in the laboratory must be accurately determined.

title: Laboratory Angle
description: Essential Criteria - The laboratory angle of the electron with respect to the J/psi direction must be correctly computed.

title: Lorentz Factor
description: Important Criteria - The calculation of the Lorentz factor gamma must be correctly applied in the context of the problem.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria - The application of conservation of energy in the decay process must be correctly utilized.

title: Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria - The use of momentum conservation in the decay must be correctly applied.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria - All units must be consistent and correctly converted where necessary.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - Common sign mistakes in calculations must be avoided.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria - Missing factors in the equations used must be identified and corrected.
